name: Normalized Evidence Record Schema
description: Schema for storing normalized evidence records after processing raw data

id.description: Unique identifier for this normalized evidence record (e.g., ev_norm_001)

entityType.description: Type of entity this evidence belongs to (candidate, idea, etc.)

entityId.description: ID of the entity this evidence belongs to

sourceClass.description: Class of the source (public-founder-proof, competitor-pricing, etc.)

supports.description: List of decision dimensions this evidence supports (traction, willingness-to-pay, etc.)

accessedOn.description: Date when this evidence was accessed

metricUnit.description: Unit of the metric (usd_mrr, usd_per_month, count, percentage)

assumption.description: Whether this evidence is based on an assumption

notes.description: Notes about what this evidence means

rawEvidenceId.description: Reference to the raw evidence this was derived from

example.title: Founder revenue proof
example.claim: This product category shows public proof of monetization
example.notes: useful for first-pass Samuel-style traction validation
